title: Power Rankings: What's the buzz? Hornets are No. 1
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 13
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: We repeat: How could you deny them No. 1? The Hornets are 11-1 in 2008 after spanking the Spurs (in San Antonio!) and have won six straight by at least 14 points. That's happened only four other times in NBA history.

rankings.summaryHtml: Funny thing about the annual Rodeo Road Trip that often sparks the Spurs' annual second-half surge: They went only 4-4 on last year's and won it all anyway. So this season's nine-gamer might be make or break. Or not.
